SMTO-TSK-0005 — A queued request changed before it could start

GUID: 503f48e1-ac66-4ad5-9d03-9248eab2e1e1
Slug: task-preparation-conflict
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • SMTO prepares queued requests ahead of time. The prepared version no longer matches this request, often because it was edited or is still being prepared, so SMTO didn't start it.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait a minute. SMTO keeps trying on its own while it finishes preparing a queued request. A queued request can't start while SMTO is still preparing it, and SMTO checks again after a few seconds.
  2. Reload the page and check that the queue in this conversation shows the version of the request you want. Editing a request replaces its prepared version, so an older version on your screen can't be started.
  3. If you changed the AI model in Settings after queueing the request, delete the queued request with its bin icon and send it again. A queued request is prepared for the model chosen when you sent it, so it can't start with a different one. It hadn't started, so sending it again doesn't repeat any work.

What success looks like

  • The request leaves the queue and its first steps appear in the conversation.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't resubmit an older copy of the request to force it through.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The task preparation is no longer the current eligible future task, is still being prepared (not ready, clarification_required, failed or consumed), or does not match the requested conversation, prompt or import identity.

What this means

  • Preparation is no longer the current eligible future task, is still non-consumable, or does not match the requested conversation/prompt/import identity. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • Preparation is no longer the current eligible future task, is still non-consumable, or does not match the requested conversation/prompt/import identity.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare current preparation status, source revision and exact task/prompt binding before compiling or submitting again.

How to fix it

  • TaskPreparations.claim_preparation and consume_preparation, and reserve_chat_attempt, raise PreparationConflict when the preparation is not current, not consumable (ready, clarification_required, failed, consumed) or mismatches the conversation, prompt or import identity. Re-read the task's current preparation and revision, wait for it to become consumable, then submit or compile again; do not reuse a stale preparation or revision.
  • Refresh current prepared task input and revision before submitting or compiling again.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended current preparation reaches a consumable state and matches the accepted task identity.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
